description: Solar Radiation Observations is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Ballarat. This dataset describes observations made of solar radiation by sensors distributed in Ballarat. The information was collected in real time by the sensors. The intended use of the information is to inform the public of the historical measured observations of solar radiation in Ballarat. The dataset is typically updated every 15 minutes. Coverage: City of Ballarat. The portal files it under the publisher City of Ballarat. Its tags are radiation, solar, solar-power, sun, sun-energy. It offers 6 resource(s) in csv, geojson, json, kml, shp. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
